    condition:

}

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTPS {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing over HTTPS via JA3 fingerprint and URI patterns"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        maltype = "trojan"
    strings:
        $s1 = "GET / HTTP/1.1" nocase
        $s2 = "Host:" nocase
        $s3 = "Connection: Keep-Alive" nocase
        $s4 = "Accept: */*" nocase
    condition:
        all of ($s*) and ja3_hash in ("7a5959277174e50838bd93614f0e8365")
}

rule Keylogger_Linux_Snake_D {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Keylogger.Linux.Snake.D"
        author = "SOC Team"
        hash = "d8a40ecc"
    strings:
        $s1 = "snprintf" nocase
        $s2 = "/dev/input/event" nocase
        $s3 = "fwrite" nocase
        $x1 = { 7F 45 4C 46 02 01 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 } // ELF header
    condition:
        $x1 at 0 and all of ($s*)
}
